svg.text: Two rows of slots 33 mm each side of the centre line: the side plates'

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tabs come up through them. In the front 280 mm (the closed box)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the slots are 22 mm apart: they carry the twisting load.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bolt holes 9 mm between slots (28 slots, 10 bolt holes 9 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Oval hole for the seat tube, 34 x 45 mm, about 100 mm from the rear end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: drop it onto the tabs, then M8 x 25 bolts down into the side plates'

svg.text: T-slots with a locknut in each window.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: every tab shows through its slot and sits flush or just proud.
